texto_aprovado: There is a longer plan, in outline. Shortly before the paid years ended, the two governments announced an agreement in principle on a modernized treaty. It has not been finalized. Canada's negotiating team includes representatives of three First Nations. In March 2025, British Columbia's government announced that the United States had paused the talks. As of August 2026, the magazine Canadian Geographic reported that the talks had not resumed.
